fields.title: Test value
fields.description: The hypothesized value to test against.

fields.title: Confidence interval (in %)
fields.description:
The limits for the confidence interval are computed using this number. The default is 95 which means that
you can be 95% confident that the true value of the parameter is in the confidence interval.

fields.title: Test columns
fields.description: A single sample t-test is performed separately for each of these columns.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица
